subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – plans, redirect and GST
body_text:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us about offering monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page, sending buyers to your own thank-you page, and adding GST to your prices.

What was completed during the call:
- You added a yearly price to your product under Pricing and confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout.
- You pasted and saved your thank-you page link in the After purchase redirect option in the product's Pages settings, and a test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.

What we discussed:
- We mentioned that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices.

What you need to do next:
1. Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer. You mentioned you planned to do this that week.

What we'll do next:
- We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

Our call continued across two recordings, so here are both parts in order:
Part 1: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-1
Part 2: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-2

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
